svg.aria-label: Level 1 swim-lane process map for Infor LN, six module lanes — Master Data, Sales, Enterprise Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing, Warehousing — across five stages: Prepare, Demand, Plan, Transfer, Execute. Master data supplies items, buy-from partner, bill of material, routing and the planning cluster row. A sales order creates demand. If on-hand plus on-order stock covers it, order planning generates no planned orders and the sales order goes straight to picking and shipping. If not, two silent gates must pass, MRP runs and produces planned production and purchase orders, and those cross the transfer boundary to become real orders. The purchase order brings raw materials into the warehouse, which feed the production order, whose finished item is received into stock and then shipped.
svg.text: Infor LN · level 1 · master data to confirmed shipment

svg.text: 7 is the spine — it chains 1–6 down this route and owns stage 4.
* Buy-from BP is the transfer's hard prerequisite — without it LN refuses to generate a
purchase order for a purchased item. The partners themselves live in Items - Purchase
Business Partner (tdipu0110m000), the Item - Business Partner tab on this screen.
